799: Friends who left you when you were in trouble will burn your heart, even if you only think of them at the hour of your death.
800: Stay close to good people who have no faults. Leave the friendship of the wrong people, even if you have to give something up to do it.
801: What is an old friendship? It is one where you never get upset, in any way, when an old friend acts freely with you because you are close.
807: People whose friendship has grown through many years of love do not stop loving, even when their friends do things that cause them great harm.
811: Even when people with bad character act so loving that they seem to want to drink you up, it is better for that friendship to shrink than to grow.
812: People who are not worth having as friends become close when they can get something and leave when they cannot. It makes no difference whether you gain or lose such friends.
813: A friend who weighs what they can get from you, a person who loves only for money, and a thief are all alike.
815: Small-minded people will not protect you, even after you have done a lot for them. It is better never to have their poor friendship than to have it.
823: Even after studying many good books, people with a bad nature find it hard to become good at heart.
825: Never trust, in anything at all, the words of people who are not with you in their hearts.
828: An enemy may hide a weapon in the hands they fold before you in respect. Their tears hide harm in the same way.
836: When a fool takes on a job they do not know how to do, the job fails, and they also end up in chains.
837: When a fool becomes very rich, strangers enjoy that money while the fool's own family goes hungry.
838: When a fool gets hold of something valuable, they are like a person who is already out of their mind and then gets drunk too.
849: If you try to make a fool see the truth, you end up looking like the fool, because the fool is sure they already see everything their own way.
850: A person who says no to what the wise people of the world say is true will be thought of as a demon on earth.
856: A person who thinks it is sweet to get ahead by fighting with others will soon see their life fail and fall apart.
858: Turning away from hatred brings good things. If you keep adding to it, harm comes rushing toward you.
859: When good times are coming, a person does not even look at hatred. When harm is coming to them, they try to make their hatred bigger.
860: All painful things come from hatred. Friendliness brings the great treasure of true goodness.
863: A person who is fearful, does not know what they should know, cannot get along with others, and will not share is very easy for enemies to beat.
864: A person whose anger never goes away and who cannot control themselves is easy for anyone to beat, at any time and in any place.
865: A person who does not look for the right way, does not do what is fitting, does not care about shame, and has no good character is a joy to their enemies.
866: A person who is blinded by anger and full of endless desire is a good enemy to have, because they will bring themselves down.
880: People who do not break the pride of enemies who hurt them are not truly alive, even though they still breathe.
884: If hidden hatred grows from a mind that is not good, it brings many troubles and turns a person's own people against them.
892: If you act without respect for great people, they will bring you trouble that never goes away.
893: If you want to ruin yourself, act without listening to advice. If you want to be destroyed, do wrong to people who have great power.
898: If great people, firm as mountains, are looked down on, even those who seemed firmly settled on earth will be wiped out along with their families.
912: Some women of bad character first weigh what they can get from a man, then speak sweetly to him. Think about what they are really like, and stay away.
931: Do not go after gambling, even if you can win. Winning at gambling is like a fish swallowing bait with an iron hook hidden in it.
